description: The PIPE surface - CREATE (incl. AUTO_INGEST, OR REPLACE, IF NOT EXISTS), ALTER SET PIPE_EXECUTION_PAUSED and REFRESH, DROP, SHOW / DESCRIBE PIPES, SYSTEM$PIPE_STATUS - over stages the fixture really creates, so every cell runs on any transport. A pipe whose COPY names a missing stage, a missing target table or a user stage refuses at CREATE with that object's own wording; VALIDATION_MODE and FILES have no place in a pipe definition while a table stage is fine; pause/resume cycles and multiple pipes stay independent; names are case-insensitive; and SHOW PIPES' cells (definition, kind STAGE, is_snowflake_managed, integration, error_integration, notification_channel) carry what CREATE declared. Converted 1:1 from features/PipesTest (now retired). The three tests naming a notification/error integration or an SNS topic skip the snowflake backend (the verification account has no such integrations), as does ALTER PIPE REFRESH (live reads the stage's cloud storage and answers 403 for the placeholder bucket).

CREATE PIPE my_pipe AS COPY INTO target_table FROM @ps FILE_FORMAT = (TYPE = 'CSV')
CREATE PIPE bad_pipe AS COPY INTO target_table FROM @no_such_stage
